name: Coca-Cola UNITED - Baton Rouge Production Plant, LA

fieldNotes.location: Roster address (8484 Airline Hwy) is an obsolete historical Coca-Cola location. The current Coca-Cola UNITED Baton Rouge production plant is at 9696 Plank Rd, Baton Rouge LA 70811, confirmed by the Coca-Cola UNITED Baton Rouge location page and Waze. Roster coords (30.4558,-91.0991) were ~10km southeast of the real plant. Identified the large white-roofed bottling complex beside Baton Rouge Metro Airport with red Coca-Cola fleet trucks at the docks.
fieldNotes.campus: 112-acre LEED-certified campus per Coca-Cola UNITED / Louisiana Economic Development: ~750,000 sq ft bottling facility, 56,000 sq ft corporate office, 50,000 sq ft fleet-maintenance building, plus support buildings. $42M expansion broke ground 2021.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Could not positively confirm a barrier or gate. The campus is reached via a long winding access road off Plank Rd; the Street View car drove freely down the access road in 2022 with no gate seen, but SV coverage ends before reaching the building checkpoint. A facility of this scale typically has a controlled entrance, but no barrier is visible in satellite or available Street View - flagged uncertain (called FALSE on visible evidence).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth confirmed at the entrance from imagery. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Very deep approach - a long access road from Plank Rd plus internal roads provide ample stacking for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Trucks observed staged in a long line on a wide internal paved area between the fleet building and the bottling plant - clear post-gate staging/queue zone.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~60 dock doors along the south and east faces of the bottling building, banded 50+. Counted from zoom-19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard on the north side of the building holds ~55 trailers visible plus additional dock-side parking; banded 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal paved aprons and a long approach road provide ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has multiple large buildings: bottling plant, corporate office, fleet-maintenance building, and support structures.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Bottling plant + office + fleet maintenance + pump/utility structure = 4 distinct buildings.

citations.claim: Baton Rouge production + distribution facility (9696 Plank Rd); produces Powerade/Vitaminwater for the system

verification.rationale: Active Coca-Cola UNITED production+distribution plant (9696 Plank Rd, Baton Rouge), LEED-certified, recently $42M-expanded.
